# Intuisity

> Intuisity is a daily intuition-training platform with guided exercises for awareness, inner knowing, pattern recognition, mindfulness, remote viewing, and reflective decision-making.

## Main site

- [Intuisity](https://www.intuisity.com/): Learn about Intuisity and access its intuition-training activities.
- [Intuisity FAQ](https://www.intuisity.com/faq.html): Answers about intuition training, daily challenges, guest access, accounts, scoring, astrology insights, and friend games.
- [About Intuisity](https://www.intuisity.com/about.html): The purpose of Intuisity, how its practice works, and who it is designed for.
- [Intuition Training Guide](https://www.intuisity.com/intuition-training.html): A practical introduction to intuition practice, first impressions, reflection, and progress tracking.
- [Remote Viewing Practice](https://www.intuisity.com/remote-viewing-practice.html): A beginner-friendly explanation of Intuisity's image-based remote viewing exercises.
- [Friend Intuition Games](https://www.intuisity.com/friend-intuition-games.html): How Intuisity's Treasure Chest friend challenges work and what skills they exercise.
- [Play Treasure Chest](https://www.intuisity.com/treasure-chest.html): Play two free Treasure Chest games against the computer or open a challenge from a friend.

## Legal and policy pages

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.intuisity.com/privacy.html): How Intuisity handles user information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.intuisity.com/terms.html): Terms governing use of Intuisity.

## Notes

- Intuisity exercises are intended for personal growth, education, and entertainment.
- Intuisity does not replace professional medical, mental-health, legal, or financial advice.
